name: PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk
summary: PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk operates as a forklift rental company in Indonesia. It offers material handling equipment, such as engine counterbalance forklifts, electric counterbalance forklifts, reach trucks, warehouse equipment, loaders, and forklift attachments, as well as BSLBATT forklift lithium batteries and chargers. The company also provides material handling solutions, including rental units and operators, output-based rental, machine installation, and forklift sales and repair. PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia.
